definitions.conflictingHeadlineResponses: A score label conflicts with the body’s rounded score or its stated rounding applied to an exact intermediate.
definitions.consistentRoundedRestatementResponses: The body explicitly repeats the same rounded total as its score label. Consistency does not certify arithmetic.
definitions.wrongIntermediateArithmeticResponses: Incorrect unrounded intermediate, subtotal, or weighted value, apart from headline-only mistakes.
definitions.duplicateLiteralCompositeLabels: Count repeated literal score labels only within a single dashboard. Separate snapshot dashboards can each have a label.
